title: Shortcut your learning with evidence
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What evidence do you have that something is possible?
Jose said that you are shortcutting the negative belief system: getting over the fear and the limitations, learning faster.
A student asked whether it relates to getting into a good school, a good job and promotions with everyone happy for you, while you are not content with your own environment.
Jose asked a student who had changed countries what she learned about adapting, and how a big external change affected her internal environment.
He said that it has changed your life because now you have evidence that gives you a positive belief system: there is a place in the world accessible to you.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write a belief you hold that you could test.
Write one piece of evidence for the other side.
Write a change that taught you to adapt.
Write the shortcut you could take.
Write what you will try this week.

check.q: What did Jose say evidence gives you?
What did a student ask about?
choices: Being content with your own environment

check.q: What did Jose say shortcutting does?

recap: Build the evidence. Shortcut the old belief.
